closure_scope: Cashahuacra local-debris-flow positive component only; does not close or resolve the compound Santa Eulalia-Rimac system contract.

observed_outcome: debris flow transitioned toward mudflow near the outlet
flow reached streets and affected housing

rainfall_context.note: The reproduced rainfall value supports event and antecedent-wetness context. It is not a direct Cashahuacra gauge measurement and is not an IRFEN threshold.

geomorphic_mechanism.mechanism: rapid local debris-flow response with downstream transition toward mudflow and urban impact

geometry.note: The geometry is a reproducible DEM-derived candidate constrained by official source scope. It is not an ANA-approved watershed boundary and is not an observed debris-flow footprint.

evidence: INGEMMET field report documents streets and housing affected at the outlet/fan.
ANA/CENEPRED source context identifies vulnerable population/exposure around Cashahuacra.

negative_control_status.note: This bounded closeout is a confirmed positive component case. Prior years and absence-of-impact records are not converted into negative controls without event-level meteorological and outcome verification.

compound_system_separation.note: A local Cashahuacra debris-flow event does not by itself demonstrate Santa Eulalia or Rimac overflow, receiving-channel capacity, or compound-system activation.

pedregal_clean_room_separation.note: Only the Cashahuacra component of the shared INGEMMET source is used here. Pedregal outcome evidence remains excluded from clean-room matching and reranking.

forbidden_promotions: model or design discharges from external studies

closure.reason: Official post-event field evidence directly confirms the 23-Mar-2015 Cashahuacra debris-flow outcome, impact chain and local geomorphic mechanism. A reproducible candidate catchment and exposure context support bounded research replay while unresolved system-scale hydraulics and lack of a negative control are carried explicitly.
does_not_authorize: closing the compound Santa Eulalia-Rimac contract
using Pedregal outcome evidence before independent safe-unblind
treating the DEM-derived catchment as an official watershed boundary
